conflicts.description: Online PCC portal requires BDT 1,500 (code 1-7301-0001-2681) while police.gov.bd offline instruction page still cites Tk 500 (code 1-2201-0001-2681).
Online portal uses treasury code 1-7301-0001-2681; offline page uses 1-2201-0001-2681.
2025 Police HQ communications claim all GD types online nationwide; older reporting and partial rollout referenced lost-and-found-only online GD.
Citizen charter 'passport verification' (15–21 days) differs from online PCC (3–7 days charter SLA); purposes and channels overlap in public language but are distinct services.
Catalogue and portal use pcc.police.gov.bd/ords/r/pcc/pcc/9; police.gov.bd menu links alternate APEX paths (e.g. f?p=500:1).
